# Vision check (generated by `scripts/vision_check.py`; do not edit by hand)

Photo `data/maps/iit_kgp_nmst_block_b.jpg` read by Amazon Bedrock, compared with the hand-digitised `data/iit_kgp_museum.json` of the same photo.
Building width assumed 81 m (the panel has no scale bar). Commit 9765bcf.

| Model | Rooms found | Exits | Valid | Median position error (m) | Evac time vision (s) | Evac time hand (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 | 14/15 | 1 | yes | 3.3 | 388.5 | 145.25 |
| us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 | 12/15 | 1 | yes | 7.9 | 745.5 | 145.25 |

How to read this:
- Rooms are matched to the hand graph by printed name. Position error = distance between room centres.
- People come from room area x use (`DENSITY` in `nikaas/vision.py`), not from the model.
- Links the model left out are added by `connect` (nearest walkway point) and listed in the graph's
  `vision.auto_links`, so a person can check them in the editor.
- Exits in the hand graph are also estimates from the panel. Fewer exits means everyone queues at one
  door, which is most of the evacuation-time gap. Confirm exits in the editor before trusting a time.
- Model output varies a little between runs; rerun the script to see the spread.
